normalization_conventions.P210: real Lambda^4 basis e_I, I sorted

A1.criterion: every independent invariant is projected to normalized PS and SM components

A2.criterion: canonical kinetic normalization and representation ancestry are verified exactly

A3.criterion: lambda4 and every retained dimension-six lock coefficient are explicit

A4.criterion: component reconstruction reproduces every canonical invariant before symmetry breaking

PS.resolution: Pi_(c6,c2L,c2R)=product of exact Lagrange spectral projectors in C2(SO6),4C2L,4C2R on each SO10-origin field block
PS.completeness: sum over every PS isotypic block equals the identity on each normalized field carrier

SM.resolution: Pi_(c3,c2L,Y6)=product of exact Lagrange spectral projectors in 12C2(SU3),4C2L and signed -i*Y6 on each SO10-origin field block
SM.completeness: sum over every SM isotypic block equals the identity on each normalized field carrier

projection_kernel.coefficient_rule: for circuit C and component labels alpha_1..alpha_n, C_alpha=C(P_alpha1 phi_1,...,P_alphan phi_n); this is an exact executable coefficient formula
projection_kernel.reconstruction_rule: sum_alpha1..alphan C_alpha=C because every inserted projector resolution sums to the identity
projection_kernel.zero_storage_policy: compact exact circuits are canonical; identically zero component combinations are evaluated as zero and are not materialized

lambda4.component_coefficient_rule: lambda4/4! times the exact PS/SM projected circuit coefficient

dimension_six_lock.channel: unique symmetric-traceless 54 contraction; chiral five-form trace identity removes an independent singlet contraction
dimension_six_lock.component_coefficient_rule: lambda_lock/4! times the exact PS/SM projected circuit coefficient
